messages.subject: Meridian - security and validation evidence
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

From the science/quality side I need comfort that the platform meets Annex 11 and our data-integrity expectations before we sign. Can we make sure the agreement requires Sentvia to maintain ISO 27001, provide SOC 2 evidence, and support GxP audit trails? And that the implementation includes proper computer-system validation (IQ/OQ/PQ)?

Stephen

messages.subject: RE: Meridian - security and validation evidence
messages.plaintextBody:
Stephen,

All covered. The warranties require ISO 27001 certification and Annex 11 / GVP alignment; the security schedule mandates SOC 2 Type II, encryption, 24x7 monitoring and tamper-evident audit trails; and the Statement of Work includes a full CSV / validation pack (IQ/OQ/PQ) as a paid milestone with a validation summary report you'll sign off. I'll send the security schedule and SOW for your file.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0112

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
